# Conformance fixtures: sources and licenses

The files in `test/fixtures/conformance/` are generated by `scripts/conformance-fixtures.py`.
Each fixture in `test/fixtures/conformance/` has a `.provenance` sibling with source repository, source commit,
input and output hashes, and license. The rows below restate those records.

| Fixture | Source | License of the source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `f1-frames.json` | `src/Orbit64/Frame.flix` of https://github.com/wstein/flix-orbit64 at `a046e34adcdc212a69ce3dcc24b2e47b7fabfbe5`; faces, up and right from `specs/001-core-foundation/data-model.md` | Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE` of flix-orbit64: Copyright 2026 Werner Stein) |
| `f4-3x3-picture.txt`, `f5-nxn-smoke.txt` | Vector rows copied unchanged from `tests/fixtures/orbit64_v2_picture_facelets.txt` of https://github.com/wstein/cubacle at `5c5d3025241a4588c59f084af46173d4178ffed1`, which copies them from `test/TestV2FaceletPictureData.flix` of flix-orbit64 at `a046e34adcdc212a69ce3dcc24b2e47b7fabfbe5` | Vectors: Apache-2.0 (flix-orbit64). Copy in cubacle: AGPL-3.0-or-later (`LICENSE`, `NOTICE.md` of cubacle) |
| `f4-3x3-picture-rotations.json` | Rows of the same cubacle file and `src/Orbit64/Frame.flix` of flix-orbit64, same commits | Vectors: Apache-2.0. Copy: AGPL-3.0-or-later (per the provenance file) |
| `f2-move-signs.json`, `f3-2x2-v1.json`, `f6-symmetry.json`, `f7-center-order.json` | Files of this repository (specs, knowledge notes, solver API, `cubistry-42-43.json`) at `b791c344dc689433c01833376e35307f72711e06` | AGPL-3.0-or-later (per the provenance files) |
| `../mapping/n3-picture-wire.txt` | Generated by `scripts/mapping-vectors-n3.jl` from `f4-3x3-picture.txt` and `wire/definition-3.json` of this repository; carries the F4 facelet rows and tokens unchanged | AGPL-3.0-or-later (derived from the Cubacle copy of F4); the Orbit64 vectors are Apache-2.0 at the origin |

A copy of the Apache-2.0 text is in `test/fixtures/LICENSE-Apache-2.0`; it is the
`LICENSE` file of flix-orbit64 at the commit named above. The provenance files
give AGPL-3.0-or-later for the files of this repository; the license text is in
`test/fixtures/COPYING`. The counter fixture `cubistry-42-43.json` is covered by
`test/fixtures/NOTICE.md`.
